description: Rank the cards matching `name`, `pokemon`, `pokedex`, `set` or `rarity` — at least one, matched as in search_cards — by one market's price, most valuable first unless `order` is 'asc'. Each card is ranked once, by its highest-priced printing in `rankMarket`: a row in `cards` gives that `variant`, its `price`, and the other market's price as `otherMarket`. Upstream cannot sort by price, so the first 300 matches are read; `truncated` says more matched, and `coverage` accounts for every card read, counting unpriced ones by the same `reason` codes get_card_pricing uses. `separatelyListedPrintings` counts printings sold separately and not ranked. A row's `warnings` flag markets more than 10× apart; the order still follows `rankMarket`. Prices show the native `amount` and a `convertedAmount` at the rate in `exchangeRates.rates`, for one copy in unspecified condition, before fees.

basis.description: Which figure to rank by. 'market' is TCGplayer's market price and Cardmarket's trend; 'low' the lowest listing; the day averages are Cardmarket's alone. So an average needs `rankMarket` 'cardmarket'.

currency.description: The currency to show prices in; it never changes the order. Each price is also given in its market's own currency.

language.description: Catalogue language. Names, values and set lists are localised (the Asian catalogues have their own set ids), so look values up in it; prices are the same in every language.

limit.description: How many rows to return; fewer when fewer cards have a price.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring of the card name. Names repeat heavily; tell results apart by set and number.

pokedex.description: Filter by a National Pokédex number. Matches any card depicting it.

pokemon.description: A Pokémon's name in the request language, resolved to its Pokédex number (echoed back) to find every card depicting it.

rankMarket.description: The one market whose price orders the ranking; each row shows the other's too.

rarity.description: Filter by the print rarity ('None' for a card printed without one).

set.description: Filter to one set by id ('sv04.5') or printed name ('Paldean Fates'), ignoring case; a name several sets share covers them all. list_sets lists both.

name: rank_card_prices

basis.description: The figure ranked by, whether requested or defaulted to.

cards.description: The ranked cards, best first in the order asked. Cards with no price in the ranked market are not listed — 'coverage' counts them.

id.description: The card's globally unique id, which get_card and get_card_pricing take.

name.description: The card's printed name in the requested language.

platform.description: Whether the card was physically printed or exists only in the digital Pokémon TCG Pocket.

anyOf.description: A rarity as the catalogue spells it.
The card was printed with no rarity symbol, which the catalogue spells 'None'.

rarity.description: The print rarity as the catalogue spells it. Names vary across eras, so two similarly scarce cards may not share one. Null for a card printed with no rarity symbol, such as a promo or a starter-deck card: the catalogue's own value for that is 'None', which is what the rarity filter takes to find them. Absent when the catalogue records no rarity at all — over half of Traditional Chinese cards — so absence is not the same as null.

set.description: The set the card belongs to.

name.description: The set's printed name in the requested language.

ageHours.description: How many hours old asOf is when this response was built, to one decimal place. Null when asOf is.

amount.description: The price in the market's own currency, for one copy in unspecified condition. A marketplace figure, not what a seller would receive after fees.

approximateVariant.description: True when the price may not be for exactly the printing named. Either the market's product covers more than it — chiefly Cardmarket, whose one product for a Jungle-to-Neo card covers 1st Edition and Unlimited alike, and whose plain column is attributed to a printing by inference when the sources disagree — or the name covers more than the product, as 'holo' does on a Base Set card, whose price is the Unlimited printing's.

anyOf.description: Upstream gave no timestamp at all.

asOf.description: When upstream last recorded this market's prices, as an ISO timestamp taken from the price data itself — never the time of this request, which can be up to an hour later than the data it served. Null if upstream gave no timestamp at all.

asOfApproximate.description: True when this market sent no timestamp of its own and asOf is the other market's, from the same upstream import.

convertedAmount.description: The price in the requested currency, rounded half-to-even to two decimals, at the rate the response's exchangeRates gives for this market's currency — the same as amount when the two currencies match. Converted at the latest reference rate, not the rate of the day the market recorded the price, so comparing markets or dates carries exchange-rate drift. Absent only when exchange rates were unavailable — the response's warnings then say why.

currency.description: The market's own currency: USD for TCGplayer, EUR for Cardmarket.

market.description: The marketplace this price is from.

amount.description: No price. 'reason' says why, and absence is never a price of zero.

market.description: The marketplace this price would be from.

reason.description: Why there is no price. 'no_listing': the market lists no product for this card at all. 'variant_unpriced': it lists the card but has no price for this printing, or none for this basis. 'variant_not_printed': the catalogue records that the card was never printed this way, so no market will price it — check the variant named. 'separate_product': the printing is sold as a marketplace product of its own whose price is not carried, such as Base Set's 1st Edition or a Poké Ball reverse. 'window_unavailable': the basis is a day average and only Cardmarket publishes those. 'platform_unpriced': a Pokémon TCG Pocket card, which is digital and never sold. 'unavailable': the card could not be read from the catalogue at all — not the same as unpriced. 'unrecognised_shape': upstream sent price data in a shape this server does not understand.

otherMarket.description: The other market's price for the same printing, for comparison only — it plays no part in the order, and may be unpriced where the ranked one is not.

ageHours.description: How many hours old asOf is when this response was built, to one decimal place. Null when asOf is.

amount.description: The price in the market's own currency, for one copy in unspecified condition. A marketplace figure, not what a seller would receive after fees.

approximateVariant.description: True when the price may not be for exactly the printing named. Either the market's product covers more than it — chiefly Cardmarket, whose one product for a Jungle-to-Neo card covers 1st Edition and Unlimited alike, and whose plain column is attributed to a printing by inference when the sources disagree — or the name covers more than the product, as 'holo' does on a Base Set card, whose price is the Unlimited printing's.

anyOf.description: Upstream gave no timestamp at all.

asOf.description: When upstream last recorded this market's prices, as an ISO timestamp taken from the price data itself — never the time of this request, which can be up to an hour later than the data it served. Null if upstream gave no timestamp at all.

asOfApproximate.description: True when this market sent no timestamp of its own and asOf is the other market's, from the same upstream import.

convertedAmount.description: The price in the requested currency, rounded half-to-even to two decimals, at the rate the response's exchangeRates gives for this market's currency — the same as amount when the two currencies match. Converted at the latest reference rate, not the rate of the day the market recorded the price, so comparing markets or dates carries exchange-rate drift. Absent only when exchange rates were unavailable — the response's warnings then say why.

currency.description: The market's own currency: USD for TCGplayer, EUR for Cardmarket.

market.description: The marketplace this price is from.

amount.description: No price. 'reason' says why, and absence is never a price of zero.

market.description: The marketplace this price would be from.

reason.description: Why there is no price. 'no_listing': the market lists no product for this card at all. 'variant_unpriced': it lists the card but has no price for this printing, or none for this basis. 'variant_not_printed': the catalogue records that the card was never printed this way, so no market will price it — check the variant named. 'separate_product': the printing is sold as a marketplace product of its own whose price is not carried, such as Base Set's 1st Edition or a Poké Ball reverse. 'window_unavailable': the basis is a day average and only Cardmarket publishes those. 'platform_unpriced': a Pokémon TCG Pocket card, which is digital and never sold. 'unavailable': the card could not be read from the catalogue at all — not the same as unpriced. 'unrecognised_shape': upstream sent price data in a shape this server does not understand.

price.description: The ranked market's price for that printing, for one copy in unspecified condition.

rank.description: The card's position in this ranking, from 1.

separatelyListedPrintings.description: How many entries in upstream's per-printing list for this card are sold under a marketplace product other than the card's main one — Poké Ball and Master Ball reverses, stamped promos, Base Set's 1st Edition and Shadowless. A printing with no marketplace product at all is not counted. They are not ranked, and may be worth more than the printing that was. Absent when there are none.

variant.description: The card's highest-priced printing in the ranked market, which is the price it was ranked by. A card is ranked once, by that printing, however many it has.

warnings.description: Anything that limits how far this entry's prices can be relied on — chiefly the two markets pricing the same printing more than 10× apart, which usually means one market's figure belongs to a different product, so neither should be trusted without checking. Absent when nothing does.

coverage.description: How much of what matched the ranking actually covers. Nothing is left out without being counted here.

considered.description: How many matching cards were read, at most 300.

ranked.description: How many of them had a price in the ranked market and basis.

summary.description: The same counts in one sentence, e.g. 'ranked 143 of 156 cards, 13 unpriced'.

unavailable.description: The ids of matching cards that could not be read from the catalogue. They are left out of the ranking but not because they lack a price — they may well have one — so retry or price them with get_card_pricing.

unpriced.description: How many were read but have no price in the ranked market and basis.

unpricedByReason.description: The unpriced cards counted by why, using the same reason codes a price carries. Reasons with no cards are left out.

rateDate.description: The 'YYYY-MM-DD' publication date of the rates used. The ECB publishes on working days only, so at a weekend this is the previous Friday's.

rates.description: How many units of the requested currency one unit of a market's currency buys, unrounded, for every pair a price here was converted through. A market already in the requested currency needs no rate and has none here.

stale.description: True when they could not be refreshed and the last ones fetched were used; rateDate says how old they are.

exchangeRates.description: The exchange rates every converted amount here used. Null when nothing needed converting, or when no rates could be fetched.

language.description: The catalogue language this response was read in.

limit.description: The most rows this response could hold, whether requested or defaulted to.

order.description: The order used, whether requested or defaulted to.

pokemon.description: What the `pokemon` filter resolved to. Absent when none was given.

name.description: The Pokémon's name as the catalogue spells it on the card it was read from.

pokedex.description: The National Pokédex number the name resolved to, which the search filtered on.

truncated.description: True when more than 300 cards matched, so only the first 300 in the catalogue's own order were considered and a card beyond them may outrank everything here. Narrow the filters until this is false to be sure of the ranking.

warnings.description: Anything that limits how far these numbers can be relied on, such as exchange rates that are stale or unavailable, or prices the two markets put more than 10× apart. Empty when nothing does.
